overview: To speak directly with Ledger support, visit the official ledger help center and use the live chat or contact form to submit your issue. 1-855⇢⇢618⇄⇄ 8738 🧠 Ledger mainly provides support through online channels rather than direct phone assistance for security reasons. 1-855⇢⇢618⇄⇄ 8738 🛸 Always use verified Ledger websites and never share your recovery phrase with anyone claiming to be support staff. 1-855⇢⇢618⇄⇄ 8738 🔐
